summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Admin Console (/admin), Help Requests inbox, Members management, and role-based file access. Backend: 32/32 pytest cases pass, including the 8 new tests for /api/help-requests (401 unauth, 403 non-admin GET, 403 non-admin PATCH, admin GET returns list with no Mongo _id, member contact submission surfaces in inbox with status 'new', status workflow new->in_progress->resolved->new persists, invalid status 422, unknown id 404) and role-gated /api/files/{id} downloads across member/business_member/committee_member/admin against All Members/Business Members/Committee Members/Restricted documents (member->403 on business+restricted, business->403 on restricted, committee->403 on restricted, admin->allowed all). Frontend Playwright: admin login via magic link -> dashboard shows nav-card-admin + nav-card-members; /admin renders all six admin-link-* management cards and help-inbox-section; admin can submit /contact and the request appears in the inbox with the correct id, help-new-count badge visible; help-status-{id} PATCH -> new -> in_progress -> resolved with filter (all/new/in_progress/resolved) narrowing correctly and persisting after reload; /members invite creates a row (duplicate email surfaces 409); role dropdown and toggle work; admin's own role & Deactivate are disabled; deactivate flips to Reactivate and back; resend-invite fires. Non-admin (member) session: /dashboard hides nav-card-admin & nav-card-members, /admin shows admin-denied. Documents page for admin shows no lock indicators (as expected).

minor.issue: No pagination — .to_list(1000) hard-caps results; over a very long timeline the inbox could truncate silently. Add limit/skip query params.

topic/message/name are not bounded — a malicious authenticated user can DoS the admin inbox with very large or unlimited messages. Add pydantic max_length constraints (e.g. topic<=200, message<=5000).

created_at is stored as ISO string, so .sort('created_at', -1) is a lexical sort. It happens to work for ISO-8601 UTC strings but is fragile — prefer storing a native BSON datetime for deterministic ordering.

critical_code_review_comments: download_file (GET /api/files/{id}) still uses user_from_token/active_member_from_token which duplicates get_current_user logic. Consolidate into a single helper that supports cookie + Authorization + ?auth= query.
put_object / get_object use blocking `requests` in async handlers — will stall the FastAPI event loop for uploads/downloads under load. Switch to httpx.AsyncClient.

server.py is now ~1050 lines mixing auth, email, storage, members, content, help-requests, files. Split into modules (auth.py, members.py, help.py, email.py, files.py, content.py) — code review comment carried over from iteration_2 still not addressed.
MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES enforced only after fully reading the file into memory; a large upload can OOM the pod. Enforce via streaming reads or Content-Length pre-check.
CORS still allows only a single origin from FRONTEND_URL. If ever hosted on multiple origins (custom domain + preview), credentialed CORS will silently break; support a comma-separated list.
Deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
PATCH /api/help-requests/{id} returns just {ok:true}; consider returning the updated request so the client can reconcile without a follow-up GET (minor).
test_credentials: Admin: stephen@cloudpoweredtech.com (magic-link, passwordless). Mint a raw token via the DB helper in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (hash-only stored).
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest transiently creates test_* members, help-requests, and injects fake files (with content.documents entries) referencing test file records; every fixture cleans up in teardown_class. Playwright created one pwtest_invite_<ts>@example.com member and one TEST_PW help request; both cleaned up after the run. Seeded admin is intact. Sample demo (SAMPLE-prefixed) content and pre-existing help requests were left as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now covers auth, members, non-admin authz, contact, help-requests inbox (new), and role-based file access (new). File-access tests inject fake file records + document listings; they expect 502 (storage download failed) as the ALLOWED path since storage_path is fake — that is intentional and validates the authorization decision, not the storage bytes. Playwright testids used: nav-card-admin/members, admin-home-page, admin-link-{reunion|business|payments|meetings|documents|members}, help-inbox-section, help-new-count, help-filter-{all|new|in_progress|resolved}, help-request-{id}, help-status-{id}, admin-denied, members-admin-page, invite-first-name/last-name/email/role, invite-submit-btn, member-row-{email}, member-role-{email}, member-toggle-{email}, member-resend-{email}, contact-name/email/phone/topic/message/submit-btn, contact-success.
